notes: All 229 pieces of the parts list are recorded (88 types/colours, counts checked). Minifigure parts (heads, torsos, legs, helmets, capes, hair, etc.) are not in the parts list and are omitted.

Connectivity: three separate groups remain on purpose because the booklet really builds three separate models. Bag 1 builds the Uruk-hai wagon/catapult (b1-b96 with its minifigure weapons). Bag 2 builds the Rohan horse with saddle and sword (b97-b103) and, separately, the castle wall section (b104-b229, with the archer's bow). The horse is only ever placed beside the castle, never fixed to it, so there is no physical join between those models.

The minifigure accessories in the parts list (halberds b91/b92, Uruk-hai swords b93/b94 and shields b95/b96, Eomer's spear b102 and shield b103, archer's bow b229) are held by minifigures that are not nodes. Each is tied with a loose other_join to the model its minifigure sits or stands on or beside: spear and shield to saddle b100, bow to top plate b182, and the Uruk-hai weapons to wagon wheels b19-b22 (step 16 shows the Uruk-hai standing beside the wagon, so these are contact-only joins, not fastenings). A sword and shield held by the same Uruk-hai are also tied to each other (b93-b95, b94-b96).

Build order: bag 1 (wagon/catapult b1-b96), bag 2 horse (b97-b103), then castle (b104-b229). Booklet part icons were matched to the parts list by element number. For example the 2x 1x4 wood-grain tiles are lego-2431pr0060 and the 1x4 plates in the castle are lego-3710. The 2x2 corner bricks 2357 are used at castle step 5. The curved-face 2x2 bricks are lego-87620.

Exact stud positions are hard to read from the small isometric drawings, so some rests_on lists are best estimates of the supporting pieces (e.g. fenders, castle wall courses and the top battlements). Piece types, colours and counts are exact.

The wedge sub-assembly (b39-b44) is attached sideways to the two end brackets b13/b14 and is therefore an other_join, not a rests_on. The red handle tile b78 sits on the studs of bracket b75, and plate b76 is pushed sideways into that bracket.

Wheel assembly: each lego-3749 axle pin passes through a hole of the lego-2730 brick, the lego-60474 wheel turns on the pin, and the lego-4032a hub is pushed onto the axle end. The arm swivels on the lego-4519 axle that goes through the angled connector into the round brick.

The fired bolts are hook b83/b84 + bush + cone + 61184 rod. The rod pin passes through a silver blade and into a pin hole of the technic brick b70. The two black 2780 pins b227/b228 go into the castle's left-hand technic brick b106 (step 35).
The first lego-3062b round brick (b218) sits loose in the launcher bucket (rests_on []). The other two sit on the top plate.
Positions are left null as requested.
